audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no real number (COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT); dosFull/dontsFull rows were verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad (COPY_PASTE_BLEED)
audit.why: Per the calibration rule, trust Riot's description over a misfiring derived flag. Calling it a root tells the reader to play around lockdown that doesn't exist and undersells that it's dodgeable/escapable as a slow.
audit.corrected: Fixed breakdown.cooldowns (COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) and dosFull[1].d/dontsFull[2].d (COPY_PASTE_BLEED) per matchup-lint.js findings.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no real cooldown numbers, and no field states that Seraphine's Encore (R) can cancel Xerath's channeled Rite of the Arcane (R) (missingInteractions rule your-channel-punished).
audit.why: Xerath's R is a self-immobilizing channel any CC cancels; Encore is a long-range charm on a 160/140/120s cooldown, so eating it mid-ult is a costly, rare, and very punishable mistake worth naming with its real timer.
Favoured 4/10 diff and a clean Xerath sweep of the level chart match the 51.33% winrate and the range/mobility gap (Xerath out-ranges every Seraphine poke tool and she has no dash).

notes: Corrected a fabricated ability effect: Beat Drop (E) was labeled and described as a Root throughout the full layer, but Riot's own text only describes a line slow ("impairs the movement of enemies in a line") — the hardCC flag on the kit misfired and contradicted the description, so per the calibration rule the description wins. Relabeled every occurrence to Beat Drop (Slow) and rewrote the mechanical claims to match. Fixed both COPY_PASTE_BLEED lint hits, both MISGENDER hits (Seraphine is she/her), and the COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT hit with real numbers (E 11s->9s, R 160/140/120s). Folded in the autoreset-burst-tell missingInteraction (Stage Presence double-cast as a disengage cue) via dosFull[1] and breakdown.trading. The content layer (win[], whys[], spikes[], early/mid/late, wants) was already correctly written around a slow, not a root, and needed no changes — it is the full layer alone that had the fabricated name.
